name: app.automessage/mcp
title: autoMessage
description: Send and read iMessages from your own Mac and Apple ID — drafts, history and contacts.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOMESSAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your autoMessage API key, from the dashboard at go.automessage.app. Use a read-only key to expose history without send access.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOMESSAGE_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to the hosted autoMessage API.

environmentVariables.name: AUTOMESSAGE_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to hide and block the send, cancel and create-contact tools. Pair with a read-only API key for server-side enforcement.
